npc.hello.elder: The old bones remember everything, child.
npc.hello.elder.0: The old bones remember everything, child.
npc.hello.elder.1: I have buried more friends than I have fingers left to count them on.
npc.hello.elder.2: Every generation thinks its troubles are the first of their kind. They never are.
npc.hello.elder.3: Keep your blade honest and your promises fewer. Both serve you longer.
npc.hello.elder.4: The forest was here before the town, and it will outlast it too.
npc.hello.elder.5: Ask me about the war sometime, if you can stomach the answer.
npc.hello.guard: Keep it quiet in here, traveler.
npc.hello.guard.0: Keep it quiet in here, traveler.
npc.hello.guard.1: Nothing gets past this gate on my watch. Mostly.
npc.hello.guard.2: You carry yourself like trouble. Good. We could use some, aimed the right way.
npc.hello.guard.3: Report anything strange past the tree line, and I mean anything.
npc.hello.guard.4: Long shift, short patience. State your business.
npc.hello.guard.5: The night watch drew straws for who takes graveyard duty. I lost.
npc.hello.king: A crown sits heavy on the brow, traveler. The realm remembers the Ember Crown - and it remembers you. Speak.
npc.hello.king.0: A crown sits heavy on the brow, traveler. The realm remembers the Ember Crown - and it remembers you. Speak.
npc.hello.king.1: Every visitor to this hall wants something. What do you want, truly?
npc.hello.king.2: The throne does not make a man wise. It only makes his mistakes louder.
npc.hello.king.3: I have read reports of your deeds. Some of them I even believe.
npc.hello.king.4: The realm was quieter before the deep places stirred again. I do not think that a coincidence.
npc.hello.king.5: Speak plainly here. Flattery is the one currency this hall has too much of.
npc.hello.merchant.1: Best prices this side of the river, and that's not just my usual line.
npc.hello.merchant.2: Everything I sell, I tested myself. Mostly on other people.
npc.hello.merchant.3: Supply's been thin since the roads got rough. Prices reflect it, sadly.
npc.hello.merchant.4: You break it, you bought it. Even before you've bought it.
npc.hello.merchant.5: A discount? For you? ...No. But nice try.
npc.hello.resident_home.0: Oh! Didn't hear you come in. Make yourself at home, traveler.
npc.hello.resident_home.1: The hearth's warm if you want to sit a while.
npc.hello.resident_home.2: Careful with the floorboards near the door, they creak something awful.
npc.hello.resident_home.3: You're welcome to rest here if the road's been long.
npc.hello.resident_home.4: My grandmother built this house with her own hands, you know.
npc.hello.resident_home.5: Quiet day. Good for mending nets and mending nothing at all.
npc.hello.resident_home.6: Don't mind the mess, I wasn't expecting company.
npc.hello.resident_home.7: If you're looking for the well, it's out on the plaza.
npc.hello.resident_palace.0: The King is not to be disturbed at this hour, traveler.
npc.hello.resident_palace.1: Mind your boots on the palace floors, they were just polished.
npc.hello.resident_palace.2: The court keeps me busier than any battlefield ever could.
npc.hello.resident_palace.3: His Majesty speaks well of those who prove their worth.
npc.hello.resident_palace.4: The old halls remember more wars than any of us have lived through.
npc.hello.resident_palace.5: Stand up straight if you mean to be noticed here.
npc.hello.resident_palace.6: The treasury is not as full as the rumors claim, sadly.
npc.hello.resident_palace.7: Every crown weighs more than it looks, or so I'm told.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.0: Business is fair this season, can't complain too loudly.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.1: Mind the crates by the door, just got a shipment in.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.2: You look like you've seen a dungeon or two. Careful out there.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.3: The town's been calmer since the guard doubled their rounds.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.4: I keep meaning to fix that shutter. One of these days.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.5: Come in, come in, no need to knock twice.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.6: Prices in the market are climbing again, mark my words.
npc.hello.resident_town_house.7: This house has been in the family three generations now.
npc.hello.villager.1: Careful in the tall grass past the fence, I heard something growl.
npc.hello.villager.2: My cousin swears the ruins to the north hum at night. Probably nothing.
npc.hello.villager.3: You look like someone who's dug a grave or two. Or dug one open.
npc.hello.villager.4: Mind the well, the rope's fraying and nobody's fixed it.
npc.hello.villager.5: If you're heading out, take a cloak. The wind bites past the tree line.
npc.rumor.boss_down: Word's already reached us - they say a %s fell in the deep places. Folk are calling it a good omen.
poi.shrine.bless: The shrine's warmth mends you (+10 hp)
poi.sign.0: West: the old town. East: worse.
poi.sign.1: Wolves ate the last cart. Walk fast.
poi.sign.2: Shrine ahead: pray once, it remembers.
poi.sign.3: Bandits camp where the road bends. Their chests travel light.
quest.deliver: Deliver a letter to the %s of %s.
quest.gate: You are not strong enough yet (Lv %s).
quest.main.boss: Face the %s. There is no other way.
quest.main.kill: The story demands %s %s dead in the %s.
quest.tone.clear: Rest for the dead is all we ask.
quest.tone.collect: We need this, traveler. Bring it back in one piece.
quest.tone.deliver: A few words that must reach the right hands.
quest.tone.kill: Something has to give - and it won't be us.
rest.wake: You rest until morning. HP and stamina restored.

story.act.0: The crown's first shard hums somewhere in these lands. The elder sees something of the old fire in you.
story.act.1: As the second shard draws near, old griefs wake in the villages - feuds that only the crown can heal.
story.act.2: The third shard lies where the dead do not sleep. Bring iron, and do not heed the whispers.
story.act.3: A demon stirs in the deep caves and dreams of the crown. The earth itself feels warmer now.
story.act.4: Two shards remain scattered. Kings and merchants quarrel over the fire, while shadows gather.
story.act.5: The graveyards groan along the border; something remembers the first shard and longs for it.
story.act.6: Snow and sand alike whisper your name. The land is waking - and not all of it is friendly.
story.act.7: A dragon guards the final deep. The old tales say its hoard holds the crown's last true light.
story.act.8: Every shard you carry burns brighter. The horizon darkens as the tale climbs toward its peak.
story.act.9: Only the crown's heart remains, hidden in the deepest dark. Make the world whole again.
story.intro.1: Long ago the Ember Crown shattered, and its shards fell into five biomes.
story.intro.2: Where a shard landed, the dead stood up. Graveyards grew like wounds.
story.intro.3: The villages forgot their names. The town of Emberhold remembered.
story.intro.4: You are the last oath-bound. No crown, no army - one sword and one road.
story.intro.5: Walk the road. Grow strong. Take back the shards - or die trying.
story.lead: The chronicle takes a new turn

victory.sub: Ten chapters, a hundred deeds - every shard is yours again. Emberhold will sing of you.
victory.title: The Ember Crown is Whole
